decisions.statement: The sign-in is read from the auth cookie rather than from a file of its own.
An auth cookie the browser split into chunks is joined back in chunk order.
A token expiring within ten minutes is not fresh.
Anything that will not decode asks for a new export rather than refusing.
Only a single unsplit base64 auth cookie is rewritten in place.
A rewritten cookie past the chunk limit is refused rather than written split.
Every field the storage state carried besides the cookies is kept.
Nothing here asks for a new token.

definition: the sign-in a Playwright storage state carries, and how fresh that sign-in is
